# Open questions

The 254 decisions the MVP stories rest on, grouped by who must answer them and most-cited first. Each story is written to the assumption until the decision is answered.

## Compass operations (81)

<a id="d-33"></a>

### D-33: Who can change a Timesheet in each state?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An Agency User edits Draft and Rejected Timesheets, and a Unit User corrects Submitted and Approved ones until lock, which stay Approved. Nobody edits a locked Timesheet, and on a Draft or Rejected one a Unit User may change only the no-show mark (D-69).

- **Assumed until answered:** They come off every Shift at that Unit that has not started, and the Agency and the Unit are told.

<a id="d-157"></a>

### D-157: How is a Shift's headcount shared among its Releases?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each Release states its headcount, and a Shift's pending and accepted Releases never total more than the Shift's headcount. More headcount sent to an Agency that already holds the Shift is added to its Release, which keeps its status and rates.

### D-164: Can a Worker be added to a Shift after it ends?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only from a Timesheet: a Worker it names who has no Assignment on the Shift is assigned there, even beyond the headcount.

### D-1: Will Foodbuy add Unit as a rate dimension (RC-6)?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. A Rate Line can price one Position at one Unit, and it wins over the Market Rate Line for that Agency and Position.

<a id="d-162"></a>

### D-162: Until when can a Shift be cancelled?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Until it starts. Cancelling a Shift cancels its pending and accepted Releases and takes its assigned Workers off it.

<a id="d-166"></a>

### D-166: Must an Agency accept a chained block as a whole and keep the same Workers on every Shift?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A chained block is a recurring Request and nothing more in MVP: each Shift has its own Release, answered on its own, and the Agency may assign different Workers to each.

<a id="d-69"></a>

### D-69: Can a Unit record a no-show before the Agency submits the Timesheet?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. A Unit User can mark a no-show on any Timesheet that is not locked, including a Draft, with a reason, and the Agency is told each time. While the mark is set, no hours can be entered.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0009), [`REQ-TIME-0006`](business-rules.md#req-time-0006), [`REQ-TIME-0009`](business-rules.md#req-time-0009), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0015`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0015)

<a id="d-129"></a>

### D-129: Until when can an Agency add tips and expenses to a Timesheet?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only while it is Draft or Rejected. A tip an Agency User enters keeps the Timesheet from automatic approval, so a Unit User sees it before it is billed.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0009), [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001), [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0016`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0016)

<a id="d-160"></a>

### D-160: Can an Agency give back a Release it has accepted?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes, until the Shift starts, with a reason. Its assigned Workers then come off the Shift.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0002), [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

<a id="d-161"></a>

### D-161: What ends a Release that no Agency has answered?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit may withdraw it, and one still pending when the Shift starts expires. Headcount that is declined, withdrawn, or expired can be sent again.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0002), [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001), [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0008)

<a id="d-195"></a>

### D-195: Can a Credential be changed once it is uploaded or decided?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. Verified and rejected are final, and a correction or a renewal is uploaded as a new Credential.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0007`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0007), [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0010`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0010)

<a id="d-5"></a>

### D-5: Does MVP include clock-in for every Agency's Workers, or start with Timesheet intake (TS-1)?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** MVP starts with Timesheet intake. Clock-in is Phase 3.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0003`](business-rules.md#req-time-0003), [`REQ-TIME-0006`](business-rules.md#req-time-0006), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0015`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0015)

<a id="d-12"></a>

### D-12: Is the Peer Rate a simple average, or weighted by volume or rating?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A simple average of the regular Bill Rates other Agencies hold on approved Rate Lines in effect today for the same Position and Market.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0009`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0009), [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0020`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0020)

<a id="d-18"></a>

### D-18: Until when can a Unit change a Shift?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Headcount, times, and site instructions can change until the Shift ends. After that its schedule is fixed, and hours are corrected on Timesheets, which are auto-approved against it (C-38).
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003), [`REQ-ORDERING-0005`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0005), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0008)

<a id="d-20"></a>

### D-20: How does a recurring Request repeat?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Its lines repeat on chosen weekdays, every one or more weeks, through an end date at most 52 weeks after the first Shift. Every Shift is created when the Request is booked.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001), [`REQ-ORDERING-0004`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0017`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0017)

<a id="d-27"></a>

### D-27: Who issues and revokes badges at a secured Unit?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Unit User over that Unit, on a badge request that Iris raises when a Worker is assigned there.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0006`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0006), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0013`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0013), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-42"></a>

### D-42: How is fill rate computed? The sheet says metrics are to be defined with Foodbuy.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Assigned Workers over headcount, on Shifts that have started. For one Agency, over the headcount of the Releases sent to it, leaving out withdrawn ones.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002), [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009)

<a id="d-52"></a>

### D-52: Is a request for a Worker by name a hold or a preference?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A preference. The Agency sees requested Workers first, may mark one unavailable with a reason, and may assign any Worker who passes the checks.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0014`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0014), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0021`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0021), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004)

<a id="d-60"></a>

### D-60: How is a Tip Pool split when some Workers' hours are entered only after other covered Timesheets have locked? Example: a $1,000 pool covers ten Workers who are scheduled for, and work, the same hours on a Friday, five from Agency X and five from Agency Y. X's hours are in that night and its Timesheets lock on Sunday; Y's hours arrive on Monday. Splitting only among Timesheets that have hours gives X's Workers $200 each and Y's Workers nothing.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Until a Worker's hours are entered, the Shift's scheduled minutes less the planned break stand in, so each Worker in the example gets $100. A Timesheet keeps the share it holds when it locks, and the rest is split again. An amount no unlocked Timesheet can take stays unallocated.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007), [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0012`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0012)

<a id="d-113"></a>

### D-113: Can a Timesheet with a missing clock time or a pending expense be submitted and approved?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It can be submitted, but a Unit User cannot approve it until the time is entered and the expense is decided.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0004`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0004), [`REQ-TIME-0002`](business-rules.md#req-time-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0003)

<a id="d-178"></a>

### D-178: How is no-show rate computed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No-show Timesheets over assigned Workers, on Shifts that were worked.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002), [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009)

<a id="d-214"></a>

### D-214: Who may clear a no-show mark?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An Agency User clears only a mark an Agency User set. A Unit User clears any mark, with a reason, until the Timesheet locks.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0009), [`REQ-TIME-0009`](business-rules.md#req-time-0009), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0015`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0015)

<a id="d-235"></a>

### D-235: When is an expense decided?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Unit User approves or rejects each expense on a Submitted Timesheet, and a decided expense never changes.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0009), [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0016`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0016)

<a id="d-266"></a>

### D-266: Does each Unit name one primary operator?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes, optionally. A Program User names one Unit User covering the Unit as the Compass person accountable for it, whom Agencies and the account team reach first. Each Request still records the Unit User who placed it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0002`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0011`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0011)

<a id="d-8"></a>

### D-8: Is the pilot one geography (Chicago was floated) or one sector?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The pilot is one geography. Its Markets, ZIP codes, Units, and Agencies are loaded before launch, and its timezone is the program timezone (D-213). Nothing else in the build depends on which geography.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-CATALOG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002), [`REQ-JOBS-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-jobs-0001)

<a id="d-50"></a>

### D-50: What must an Agency give to add a Worker?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A first and a last name. Email, phone, city, Positions, and photo are optional (C-30).
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)

<a id="d-55"></a>

### D-55: Which effective dates may a new Rate Line take?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Any date, past or future, on or after the start of every approved line for the same Agency, Position, and Market or Unit. It ends the line in effect on that date.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0009`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0009), [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009)

<a id="d-56"></a>

### D-56: How is a Credential Requirement scoped?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** By org node and Position, either of which may be left open, and never for a single Event. A Program User adds and removes requirements, one for each Credential Type, org node, and Position.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0004`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0004)

<a id="d-72"></a>

### D-72: Who is told when a change adds overtime?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Worker's Agency Users and the Unit Users over the Unit of the Shift that added the overtime, in the app only. The User whose action caused it is told in the answer to that action instead.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-77"></a>

### D-77: Can an approved Rate Line be ended without a new line replacing it?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. A Program User ends it with an end date on or after its start and a reason, and from then the Agency has no contracted rate there until a new line is approved. The Agency sees the end and its reason in its rate history, and is not notified.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0003`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0003), [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009)

<a id="d-78"></a>

### D-78: Must every Rate Line give all six rates?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes: a Pay Rate and a Bill Rate for regular, overtime, and double-time hours, as on the PRD rate card. If the pilot rate data (I-5) lacks some, Compass or the Agencies supply them before the rates are loaded.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-RATES-0001`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0001), [`REQ-RATES-0002`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0002)

<a id="d-84"></a>

### D-84: Who sees the Peer Rate?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Program Users, beside each line. An Agency User is told only that a rate is above its peers, and never sees the Peer Rate or another Agency's rate.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0005`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0005), [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)

<a id="d-87"></a>

### D-87: What does an Agency see about other Agencies holding the same Shift? The sessions report that Agencies cannot tell today whether they are the only one, and the PRD's shared Shift detail names every Supplier.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An Agency sees the Shift's whole headcount, its own Release's headcount, whether any other Agency holds a pending or accepted Release on the Shift, and the total headcount those hold. It never sees the other Agencies' names, rates, answers, or Workers.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0002), [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002)

<a id="d-96"></a>

### D-96: How do a Unit's existing favorite and block lists get into Iris? The sheet says favorite rosters must carry over.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Unit User rates each Worker in Iris, one at a time, once the Worker's Agency has added them; a rating can be given before the Worker's first Shift there. There is no ratings file in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0004`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0004), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0005`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0005)

<a id="d-109"></a>

### D-109: In what order are Agencies offered to a Unit User who is choosing one for a Shift?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Agencies offered for a Shift show approved ones first, lowest contracted rate first.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0005`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0005), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0009)

<a id="d-128"></a>

### D-128: Who keeps the cashier PIN map?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Unit Users, for the Units in their scope. Each PIN maps to one Worker for a range of dates.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0012`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0012)

<a id="d-131"></a>

### D-131: Are the sheet's "top operators" Units or people?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Operators are ranked as Units.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009)

<a id="d-132"></a>

### D-132: Until when can a Unit enter or change tips?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Until the first Timesheet the tip would cover locks. A Tip Pool, a change to one, or a PIN tip that would cover a locked Timesheet is refused, so tips that arrive later cannot be entered in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0012`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0012)

<a id="d-135"></a>

### D-135: Who is told when a tip a Unit entered may not reach the Workers it was meant for?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit Users over the Unit, in the app: when a Timesheet change leaves part of a Tip Pool unallocated or makes a Timesheet holding a PIN tip a no-show, and once for a pool when a share locks while another Worker's hours are missing.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007), [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

<a id="d-149"></a>

### D-149: Who at a Unit is told when a Worker is assigned to a Shift or comes off it?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every active Unit User whose scope covers the Shift's Unit, not only the User who created the Request, who may be away or deactivated.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0005`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0005), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-158"></a>

### D-158: Until when can a Shift be sent to an Agency?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A new Release can be sent until the Shift starts. From then until it ends, headcount can only be added to an accepted Release.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0009)

<a id="d-159"></a>

### D-159: Can an Agency accept part of a Release?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. It accepts or declines the whole headcount, and a decline needs a reason.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0002), [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002)

<a id="d-189"></a>

### D-189: Can an Agency change or deactivate its Workers?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. An Agency User changes the details of their Agency's Workers and makes them inactive or active. An inactive Worker cannot be assigned.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)

<a id="d-190"></a>

### D-190: Which Workers can a Unit request by name?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Any active Worker of the Agency receiving the Shift, whether or not they have worked at the Unit, except those the Unit has blocked.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0021`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0021), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004)

<a id="d-196"></a>

### D-196: Through which date does a Credential or an Attestation count?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Through its expiry date, or the Attestation's valid-until date, that day included. One with no such date counts without end.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0004), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0010`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0010)

<a id="d-242"></a>

### D-242: What happens to a Tip Pool entered for an Event when a Shift is later attached to that Event, moved to another, or detached from it?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The pool is split again across the Timesheets it then covers. A locked Timesheet of the moved Shift keeps the share it holds and gets none from a pool it joins.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0011`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011), [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

<a id="d-260"></a>

### D-260: Are the rate and Agency gates checked again when headcount is added to a Release?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes, at the Release's stored rates against today's Rate Line and approvals. A hard gate refuses the added headcount, and a soft gate needs a reason when the Release holds none.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0009)

<a id="d-6"></a>

### D-6: Do Requests start in Iris, or in MyStaff from day one (PLT-11, PLT-12)?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Requests start in Iris. MyStaff integration is Phase 3.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001)

<a id="d-70"></a>

### D-70: Which kinds of expense can an Agency add?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Parking and background check, which the sessions name, and other, which needs a note.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)

<a id="d-83"></a>

### D-83: PLT-2 lists Department as the lowest level of the hierarchy. Can access, Settings, Agency approvals, or Credential Requirements be scoped to a Department?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A Department sits inside one Unit and is its own cost center, so spend rolls up through it. Role Grants, Settings, Agency approvals, and Credential Requirements are scoped to a Unit or a level above it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0001`](business-rules.md#req-org-0001)

<a id="d-91"></a>

### D-91: Which details of an Agency's Worker does a Unit User see?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Worker's name, photo, and Agency, as on the PRD's Shift detail. A Unit User never sees a Worker's email or phone; a Unit reaches a Worker through the Agency.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)

<a id="d-104"></a>

### D-104: Which issuers and public registries does MVP check a Credential against (WA-15)?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** None. No issuer or public registry is connected until Compass names the providers it relies on (I-6), so every such check returns not available, and a Credential rests on the document checks and a Program User's review.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTEGRATIONS-0006`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-integrations-0006)

<a id="d-153"></a>

### D-153: How soon after it is approved may a Timesheet lock?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Never sooner than 24 hours after it is approved, so a Unit User can review every approval, including an automatic one.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007)

<a id="d-168"></a>

### D-168: Does MVP need a view-only role?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. The only roles are Unit User, Agency User, Program User, and Instawork Admin.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)

<a id="d-169"></a>

### D-169: Is a badge request for each Worker at a Unit, or for each Assignment?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** For each Worker at each secured Unit. Later Assignments there reuse it, and a revoked one is raised again at the Worker's next Assignment.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0006`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0006)

<a id="d-170"></a>

### D-170: Does a badge that is not yet issued stop a Worker being assigned?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A badge request in any status never stops an assignment and is not part of eligibility.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0006`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0006)

<a id="d-179"></a>

### D-179: Which hours do reports count?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The minutes behind spend: worked minutes on approved Timesheets, plus the entered or scheduled minutes in pending spend. Overtime hours are the overtime and double-time minutes within them.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002)

<a id="d-180"></a>

### D-180: Which Shifts count toward headcount requested?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every Shift that is not cancelled.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002)

<a id="d-181"></a>

### D-181: How is an Agency's average Bill Rate computed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Its spend on hours divided by its hours.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008)

<a id="d-194"></a>

### D-194: Which check results verify or reject a Credential without a person?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Rejected when the document's expiry date has passed or the issuer or registry does not confirm it; verified when no sign of editing is found, the document matches the details uploaded, and every check that ran passed. Anything else goes to a Program User.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003)

<a id="d-217"></a>

### D-217: When is a rate flagged as above its peers?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** When it is at least the Peer Rate, rounded half up to the cent, plus the threshold percent of it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)

<a id="d-234"></a>

### D-234: What happens to a PIN tip that cannot be placed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It is refused when the PIN is not mapped on that date, or its Worker has no Timesheet at the Unit that day that is neither a no-show nor locked. Otherwise it goes to the earliest such Timesheet.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

<a id="d-243"></a>

### D-243: Whose overtime hard block and alert apply when an assignment or hours change at one Unit adds overtime to the Worker's Shift at another Unit?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Those of the Unit whose Shift gains the overtime and those of the Unit where the change is made. An assignment is refused when either Unit has the hard block on; otherwise the Unit Users over both are alerted.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003)

<a id="d-244"></a>

### D-244: What may a Unit User see of a Worker's Timesheet at another Unit whose Work Week starts on a different day from their own Unit's?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only that Unit's name and the weekday its Work Week starts, even when the Unit is outside their scope.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0003)

<a id="d-258"></a>

### D-258: When a Worker has several Attestations for one Credential Type, which one counts?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only the latest by the time it was attested. An earlier one never counts again, even after the latest has lapsed.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0004)

## Compass HR, legal, and payroll (14)

<a id="d-15"></a>

### D-15: Which tip tax rules must Iris apply at launch (TS-13)?

- **Status:** open, blocking
- **Assumed until answered:** No rule is applied until Compass names the rules.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0003`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0003)

<a id="d-133"></a>

### D-133: Whose Work Week governs when the Units an Agency sends a Worker to start their weeks on different days? Example, with overtime after 40 hours a week: Unit A's week starts Monday and Unit B's Thursday. Ten hours a day Monday to Wednesday at A and Thursday to Saturday at B bill no overtime; the same days with the Units swapped bill 20 hours of it. Needs HR, legal, and payroll.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each Timesheet is classified in its own Unit's Work Week, counting the Worker's minutes at every Unit on that week's dates, and an assignment or hours change is checked in each such week. The Timesheet checked later carries MIXED_WORK_WEEKS, so a Unit User sees it before approval.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0006`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0006), [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003), [`REQ-LABOR-0004`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0004), [`REQ-LABOR-0005`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0005), [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001), [`REQ-TIME-0005`](business-rules.md#req-time-0005), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-4"></a>

### D-4: Who owes overtime when a Worker spans Units or Agencies? Needs HR, legal, and payroll.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Overtime is counted per Worker per Agency: hours at every Unit that Agency sends the Worker to count together. Hours with other Agencies are not combined in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0006`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0006), [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003), [`REQ-LABOR-0005`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0005), [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-23"></a>

### D-23: Do break and minimum-wage checks at booking flag the Shift or block it?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** They flag. Only overtime has an optional hard block, per WA-19.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0002`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0002), [`REQ-ORDERING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0002`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0002)

<a id="d-57"></a>

### D-57: How is a required meal break checked?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A meal break is missed when the minutes worked are more than the rule's threshold and the unpaid break is shorter than the rule requires. Only one meal break is checked for a Shift.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0001`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0001), [`REQ-LABOR-0002`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0002)

<a id="d-58"></a>

### D-58: How do daily and weekly overtime combine?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Daily double time and daily overtime apply first, and only the minutes they leave regular count toward the weekly threshold. A day's and a week's minutes are counted across Units.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003), [`REQ-LABOR-0005`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0005)

<a id="d-126"></a>

### D-126: Which Workers share a Tip Pool?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Tip Pool is for one Unit and work date and can be narrowed to one Shift or one Event there. A pool splits across every covered Timesheet, whatever the Agency.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0012`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0012)

<a id="d-127"></a>

### D-127: Is a tip entered under a cashier PIN split by hours, or does it go whole to that PIN's Worker?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A tip under a cashier PIN goes to that PIN's Worker and is not split.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0012`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0012)

<a id="d-199"></a>

### D-199: Which labor rules apply where none is loaded?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** None. Iris applies only the rules loaded for a state or city, one of each kind on any date, and has no built-in defaults.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0004`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0004), [`REQ-LABOR-0001`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0001)

<a id="d-201"></a>

### D-201: In what order are a Worker's minutes classified?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** In clock-in order, each Timesheet on its Shift's work date. Locked Timesheets keep their classes, and their regular minutes count first toward the weekly threshold, so hours entered late still carry the overtime the week owes.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0004`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0004), [`REQ-LABOR-0005`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0005)

<a id="d-202"></a>

### D-202: Which minutes count toward overtime before a Timesheet has hours?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Shift's scheduled minutes less the planned break, until hours are entered. A check made when a Worker is assigned counts only scheduled minutes.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003), [`REQ-LABOR-0005`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0005)

<a id="d-198"></a>

### D-198: Are paid rest breaks checked?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. Paid rest breaks are not recorded, so rest-break rules are held for reference and not checked in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0002`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0002)

<a id="d-200"></a>

### D-200: Is the minimum wage checked when the Agency has no Rate Line?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. Without a Rate Line there is no Pay Rate to compare.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0002`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0002)

<a id="d-203"></a>

### D-203: Which start day applies to past weeks after a Unit's Work Week start changes?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit's current start day, for every date.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-LABOR-0004`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0004)

## Compass finance (18)

<a id="d-29"></a>

### D-29: What counts as pending spend?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Hours on Shifts that have ended whose Timesheets are not yet approved, priced at the Timesheet's Bill Rates: entered hours by hour class, or scheduled hours at the regular rate, shown as an estimate. Tips and expenses count only once their Timesheet is approved.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0013`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0013), [`REQ-REPORTING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0001), [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002), [`REQ-REPORTING-0004`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004), [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0010`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0010), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0014`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0014)

<a id="d-68"></a>

### D-68: May an Agency bill a Bill Rate on a Timesheet other than the rate its Shift was sent at?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A Timesheet bills its Release's rates, or the Rate Line's for a part split to another Position, and nobody edits them. The reason for an off-contract rate is the one given when the Shift was sent, and a wrong rate is corrected with invoicing in Phase 2.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0009), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0011`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0011), [`REQ-RATES-0007`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0007), [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001), [`REQ-TIME-0005`](business-rules.md#req-time-0005), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0003)

<a id="d-125"></a>

### D-125: Which weeks, months, and periods do dashboards and reports use?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit's Work Week and the calendar month. A report period is one Work Week, one calendar month, or a range of dates.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002), [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003), [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009), [`REQ-SHELL-0012`](every-user.md#req-shell-0012), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0006`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0006)

<a id="d-19"></a>

### D-19: When a Unit books more Workers than it needs, such as 55 for 50, which Workers are billed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every Worker who works is billed. The headcount needed is recorded on the Shift and has no effect on billing; MVP reports do not use it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003), [`REQ-ORDERING-0005`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0005), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0018`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0018), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-136"></a>

### D-136: What does a no-show Timesheet add to spend?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No hours amount and no tips. An approved Expense on it still counts.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0001), [`REQ-TIME-0009`](business-rules.md#req-time-0009), [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001), [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

<a id="d-276"></a>

### D-276: Is each Department a cost center, and what groups Units above them?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. Each Department has its own Compass cost center code, and every Shift and Timesheet is charged to one, so every Unit has at least one Department. Each Unit belongs to a Company, such as Soldier Field Concessions. A Department's address is copied from its Unit and may differ.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001), [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002), [`REQ-ORG-0003`](business-rules.md#req-org-0003), [`REQ-TIME-0008`](business-rules.md#req-time-0008)

<a id="d-24"></a>

### D-24: When a Unit changes the Bill Rate on a Release, or sends off-contract with no Rate Line, what are the overtime and double-time Bill Rates?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A changed regular rate scales the contracted overtime and double-time rates by the same ratio. With no Rate Line, overtime is 1.5 times and double time 2 times the regular rate the Unit enters.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001), [`REQ-RATES-0007`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0007), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0009`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0009)

<a id="d-41"></a>

### D-41: How are money amounts rounded?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Half up to the cent, for each Timesheet and each hour class. Totals add the rounded amounts.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0001), [`REQ-SHELL-0013`](every-user.md#req-shell-0013), [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001)

<a id="d-43"></a>

### D-43: Which dates count in labor cost as a percentage of sales?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only dates with revenue above zero, in both the spend and the revenue.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0006`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0006)

<a id="d-44"></a>

### D-44: How is an Event's projected cost computed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Over the pending and accepted Releases of the Event's Shifts: headcount times scheduled minutes times the regular Bill Rate, rounded for each Release. It holds no tips, expenses, or overtime premium.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0004`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0004)

<a id="d-110"></a>

### D-110: Which Bill Rates does a part of a Timesheet take when it is split to a Position with no Rate Line?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A part in a Position with no Rate Line keeps the original rates and is an exception.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0005`](business-rules.md#req-time-0005), [`REQ-TIME-0008`](business-rules.md#req-time-0008)

<a id="d-154"></a>

### D-154: What period does a budget cover?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each Budget row carries its own start and end dates, and a Unit's rows never overlap. A budget for any other period is prorated by days, and a period with no Budget day shows no budget, not zero.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007), [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008)

<a id="d-233"></a>

### D-233: What is a period to date compared with?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The whole prior period, and the whole month's budget.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0008), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0014`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0014)

<a id="d-14"></a>

### D-14: Is a budget set for each Unit, or also for each Department?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** For each Unit only. Department budgets are not part of MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007)

<a id="d-134"></a>

### D-134: How are the cents left over from a Tip Pool's split shared?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Shares are rounded down to the cent, and leftover cents go one each to the shares with the largest dropped fractions, ties to the lowest Timesheet id.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

<a id="d-155"></a>

### D-155: Who loads budgets?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Program User, from a file.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007)

<a id="d-184"></a>

### D-184: Does labor cost include Compass's own employees?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. It is agency spend in Iris only.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006)

<a id="d-193"></a>

### D-193: Does a Release follow a Rate Line that changes after the Shift was sent?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A Release keeps the rates it was sent at, and the variance check flags the difference.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)

## Instawork product (114)

<a id="d-108"></a>

### D-108: Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Rows that need action first, the most urgent on top: soonest for work ahead, oldest for work waiting. Finished rows follow, newest first, reference lists and rosters sort by name, and each screen's rule gives its exact order.

- **Status:** open

<a id="d-26"></a>

### D-26: Who keeps reference data: Positions, Markets, and labor rules?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Instawork staff, as Instawork Admins. An Instawork Admin is created only from the deployment configuration (D-97), never by invite.

<a id="d-253"></a>

### D-253: Which facts does a notification's message carry?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Enough to tell which record it means without opening Iris: for work on a Shift, its Unit, Position, date, and times; the Worker or Agency concerned; and any reason given. Each owner's rule lists its facts.

<a id="d-54"></a>

### D-54: Which names identify a record when a file or a form refers to it?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Unique names: an org node's under its parent, and a Sector's, a Unit's, and an Agency's across the program, so a file names a Unit or an Agency by name alone. A Region or District name that several nodes share is settled by its path from the Sector.

### D-37: Which records are audited?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every create, update, and delete of a product record or a User, saved with the change; one saved from a Proposal records the Proposal and its channel. Proposals, Uploads, Notifications, inbound messages, links, Sessions, and sign-in times are not audited, and passwords and link tokens never appear.

<a id="d-191"></a>

### D-191: Can an org node, Unit, Department, Agency, Position, or Credential Type be deleted?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. It is made inactive, which keeps its records and stops new use, and it can be made active again.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001`](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001), [`REQ-CATALOG-0001`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001), [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0001), [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001), [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0004`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0004)

<a id="d-265"></a>

### D-265: Which Instawork account team roles does Iris keep for parts of the Compass org?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Account Manager, Account Owner, and Support Lead. Instawork Admins assign one person per role for the whole program or any org node, and each Unit takes the nearest assignment above it, so Compass, Agencies, and Iris's agents know whom at Instawork to reach.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001), [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0005`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0005), [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009), [`REQ-ORG-0011`](business-rules.md#req-org-0011), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0002`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0011`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0011)

<a id="d-65"></a>

### D-65: Which screens does a Program User have?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Program menu is Home, Shifts, Workers, Rates, Credentials, Agencies, Org, Users, Reports, Uploads, and Settings; the rate approval queue and Rate Reviews are tabs of Rates, and Credential setup, the review queue, and Attestations are tabs of Credentials. Invoices join in Phase 2 and Agency performance in Phase 3.

<a id="d-171"></a>

### D-171: What is the shortest password Iris accepts?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** 12 characters. A password is set or changed only through an emailed link, except the first Instawork Admin's, which comes from the deployment configuration.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0003), [`REQ-SHELL-0005`](every-user.md#req-shell-0005), [`REQ-SHELL-0006`](every-user.md#req-shell-0006)

<a id="d-182"></a>

### D-182: What does a rate or percentage show when it has nothing to divide by?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Not available, never zero.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002), [`REQ-REPORTING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0006), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0006`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0006)

<a id="d-185"></a>

### D-185: Who can open a Saved Report?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only the User who saved it. It keeps the question, not the numbers, and is recomputed within that User's scope each time it is opened.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0005`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003), [`REQ-SHELL-0012`](every-user.md#req-shell-0012), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0006`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0006)

<a id="d-66"></a>

### D-66: What does a roster show as a Worker's compliance, when Credential Requirements differ by Unit and Position? The PRD shows one compliance status for each person.

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The state of the Worker's Credentials, not one compliant flag: how many need action (rejected, expired, or expiring, with no newer Credential of the type) and how many are in review. Whether a Worker meets one Shift's requirements is shown only where a Shift is chosen.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0007`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0007), [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0011`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0011), [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0012`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0012)

<a id="d-82"></a>

### D-82: When may an Instawork Admin invite a Program User?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Whenever no active User who has accepted their invite holds an unrevoked Program User grant: the first one, or a replacement if the last is lost. Until one accepts, the Instawork Admin may send the invite again or revoke it.

<a id="d-89"></a>

### D-89: What happens to a Worker's upcoming Assignments when their Agency makes them inactive?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** They come off every Shift that has not started, as when a Unit blocks them (D-51), and the Unit Users over each Shift's Unit are told. Assignments on Shifts that have started stay.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

<a id="d-102"></a>

### D-102: What does a Proposal item carry?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** One flat set of names and values: the catalog's column names for a file row, and names its proposing requirement chooses otherwise. Each problem names its field, says what is wrong, and carries a fix, candidates to pick from, or neither.

<a id="d-152"></a>

### D-152: What happens when an invite names an email a User already holds?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Nothing: the invite returns that User, and a new link goes out only when the inviter asks to send the invite again before it is accepted. Two rows or requests that name one new person send one invite. An invite for a deactivated User's email is refused.
