<a id="d-213"></a>

### D-213: Which timezone does Iris use for things that belong to no Unit, such as a Credential's expiry or a Rate Line's effective date?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The timezone of the pilot geography that D-8 asks Compass about: America/New_York for Atlanta, the one pilot market the sheet names, and America/Chicago if the pilot is Chicago, which the sheet also floats.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001), [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), [`REQ-JOBS-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-jobs-0001), [`REQ-RATES-0008`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)

<a id="d-64"></a>

### D-64: Which screens does a Unit User have?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit menu is Home, Shifts, Timesheets, Tips, Workers, Agencies, Events, Reports, Uploads, and Setup; invoices join in Phase 2. Setup holds Request templates, Position defaults, and default site instructions.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](every-user.md#req-shell-0009), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0001`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0001), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0011`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0011)

<a id="d-71"></a>

### D-71: What stops a tips or expense file sent twice from doubling the money?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A tip or an expense that repeats a saved one, or an earlier row, in the fields that identify it is shown as a duplicate whose suggested fix is to reject it. The sender decides, because two equal tips or expenses can both be real.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001), [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002), [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)

<a id="d-88"></a>

### D-88: What happens when an assigned Worker has no email and no phone, so site instructions cannot be sent to them?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Nothing is sent to the Worker. The Agency User who assigns them is told in the answer to the assignment, and the Agency's other active Agency Users are told in the app each time instructions would have been sent, so the Agency passes them on.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0006`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0006), [`REQ-ORDERING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0006), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-115"></a>

### D-115: What does a bulk submit or approve do with the Timesheets it cannot process?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A bulk step skips what it cannot do and lists it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0004`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0004), [`REQ-TIME-0002`](business-rules.md#req-time-0002), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0003)

<a id="d-117"></a>

### D-117: Do the sign-in and reset pages reveal whether an email has an account?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A refused sign-in does not say which part was wrong, and a reset request shows the same message whether or not the email matched.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002), [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](every-user.md#req-shell-0004), [`REQ-SHELL-0005`](every-user.md#req-shell-0005)

<a id="d-123"></a>

### D-123: Which screens does an Agency User have?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Agency menu is Home, Shifts, Workers, Timesheets, Rate Card, Uploads, and Users, and Worker issues are a tab of Workers. Invoices join in Phase 2 and Agency performance in Phase 3.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0001`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0001), [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0008`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0008), [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](every-user.md#req-shell-0009)

<a id="d-144"></a>

### D-144: Does Iris accept phone numbers from outside the United States?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A phone is a US number of 10 digits, however it is typed.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)

<a id="d-156"></a>

### D-156: How is a Setting's value found for one Unit?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** From the nearest org node at or above the Unit that sets it, then the program default, then the catalog default. A key the catalog scopes as program takes only a program default.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0006`](business-rules.md#req-org-0006), [`REQ-ORG-0010`](business-rules.md#req-org-0010), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0008`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0008)

<a id="d-172"></a>

### D-172: Which of their own details can a User change?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Their first name, last name, and phone. The email is the sign-in name, unique, and nobody can change it in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0003), [`REQ-SHELL-0006`](every-user.md#req-shell-0006)

<a id="d-173"></a>

### D-173: Does an open Proposal expire?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. It stays open until its User decides it, and a decided Proposal never changes again, so a failed item is retried in a new one.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002), [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0002), [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-174"></a>

### D-174: Are a Proposal's accepted items saved together or one by one?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** One by one, in list order, through the one save step that the owner of its kind registers. Each item is rechecked and saved whole or not at all, a failed item stops no other, and items that share a group key are saved in one call as one record.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002), [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002)

<a id="d-207"></a>

### D-207: What does a to-do line show beside its count?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** What is at stake: the time until the earliest Shift starts, the age of the oldest item, the earliest expiry date, the total billed amount, or the largest gap in dollars. A to-do is work the User can do themselves.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0011`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0011), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0013`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0013), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0014`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0014)

<a id="d-209"></a>

### D-209: Which changes to a Shift can a typed request or a message make?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Unit User can change a Shift's headcount or times, or cancel it. The request must identify the Shift by Unit, Position, date, and start time, and becomes a Proposal saved under the Shift edit rules once approved.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003), [`REQ-ORDERING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0010), [`REQ-ORDERING-0015`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0015)

<a id="d-225"></a>

### D-225: Which names does Iris offer when a name matches no record, or several?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** For no match, the three closest stored names by single-character edits, the closest also being the fix when it is closest alone. For several matches, every matching record, with no fix.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0002)

<a id="d-238"></a>

### D-238: In which role does the sender of an email, text, or call act?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** As a Unit User across their unrevoked Unit User grants, which the requirement that handles the message supplies. A sender with none is refused.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002), [`REQ-ORDERING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0010), [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-257"></a>

### D-257: Who deactivates an Instawork Admin?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Another Instawork Admin, never themselves, and no Program User. A new one comes only from changing the configured email and starting Iris again, which leaves the earlier one active until it is deactivated.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001), [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005), [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-30"></a>

### D-30: What does spend "far above normal" mean on the Program home?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each Unit shows this month's spend as a percentage of the average of its prior full calendar months, up to three, and no comparison when it has none. MVP shows the number and sets no flag threshold.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0013`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0013), [`REQ-REPORTING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0009)

<a id="d-34"></a>

### D-34: How long does an invite or reset link work?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** For 72 hours, and once. A new link ends the User's earlier links of the same purpose, and only a hash of the link's token is stored.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002), [`REQ-SHELL-0005`](every-user.md#req-shell-0005)

<a id="d-36"></a>

### D-36: Who may decide a Proposal?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only the User it was made for.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002), [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0002)

<a id="d-40"></a>

### D-40: Which kinds of file does each upload type accept?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** CSV and Excel for every type except Credentials, which are documents and have no template; PDF and image files for Timesheets, tips, expenses, and Credentials. An unreadable, unsupported, or empty file fails.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001), [`REQ-INTAKE-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0003)

<a id="d-45"></a>

### D-45: Who may ask reporting questions?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Unit Users and Program Users, within their scope. Agency Users get no reports in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0003`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0003), [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004)

<a id="d-59"></a>

### D-59: What does a new part of a split Timesheet start with?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The status and details of the Timesheet it came from. The break stays on the first part unless the user moves minutes, and a part can be split again.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0009), [`REQ-TIME-0008`](business-rules.md#req-time-0008)

<a id="d-61"></a>

### D-61: How does a User with several roles choose and switch the one they act in?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A User with several contexts, as D-81 defines them, chooses one at each sign-in and can switch without signing out. Switching changes the menu and no record, and a User with no unrevoked grant can only sign out.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0002`](every-user.md#req-shell-0002), [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](every-user.md#req-shell-0004)

<a id="d-73"></a>

### D-73: How is the answer to a reporting question displayed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The display follows from the shape of the answer: one measure by one dimension is a bar chart, or a line chart over time, any other single measure is a table, and several measures form a dashboard. A Saved Report stores no display choice.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004), [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003)

<a id="d-74"></a>

### D-74: Which relative periods can a Saved Report use?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** This Work Week and this month, both to date, the last full Work Week, the last four full Work Weeks, and the last full month. Each is resolved on the day the report is opened, for each Unit in its own timezone and Work Week.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003), [`REQ-SHELL-0012`](every-user.md#req-shell-0012)

<a id="d-75"></a>

### D-75: Which measures and dimensions can a question or a report use?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only those in the data model's Measure and Dimension lists. Tips, expenses, and overtime dollars are part of spend, there is no Worker dimension, and Pay Rates and Markups are never measures, so no report shows them.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003), [`REQ-REPORTING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0010)

<a id="d-76"></a>

### D-76: How are the figures on a report rounded?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A percentage or rate is computed from unrounded totals and rounded half up to one decimal place. An average Bill Rate and each prorated Budget are rounded half up to the cent, the Budgets before they are added.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0001), [`REQ-REPORTING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007)

<a id="d-80"></a>

### D-80: In what order may org nodes be made inactive and active again?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Sector, Region, or District is made inactive only when every node beneath it is already inactive, and a node or a Unit is made active again only while its parent is active. So an active Unit always sits under active nodes.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002), [`REQ-ORG-0008`](business-rules.md#req-org-0008)

<a id="d-81"></a>

### D-81: Does a User who holds several Role Grants act with all of them at once, or only as the role they chose?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only as the role they chose. Every request carries an acting context: one role and, for an Agency User, one Agency. A Unit User context covers all the User's Unit User grants, and their other grants count for nothing until they switch.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009), [`REQ-SHELL-0002`](every-user.md#req-shell-0002)

<a id="d-85"></a>

### D-85: Where does a Unit's time zone come from?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Program User may enter it. When it is left empty, Iris fills it from the Unit's ZIP code, using a ZIP code table shipped with the build, and refuses the Unit when the table lacks that ZIP code.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002), [`REQ-ORG-0003`](business-rules.md#req-org-0003)

<a id="d-90"></a>

### D-90: When does Iris recheck the eligibility of assigned Workers?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each day at 06:00 in each Unit's timezone, so an Agency learns of a removal at the start of its working day, and whenever a Shift's date or times change.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

<a id="d-93"></a>

### D-93: Does a spoken yes on a call approve a draft?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. A spoken yes approves the draft read aloud on that call, and a spoken no rejects it. The call's transcript is the record, and the Proposal records the caller as the User who decided it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002), [`REQ-ORDERING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0010)

<a id="d-94"></a>

### D-94: Can a Shift's Unit, Position, or Department change after it is booked?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No, because Releases hold rates for the Position; a Shift booked for the wrong one is cancelled and booked again. Its date can change with its times (D-18).
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0008)

<a id="d-95"></a>

### D-95: Can a Unit take back a request for a Worker by name?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes, until the Shift starts, which removes the request.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0021`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0021), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004)

<a id="d-114"></a>

### D-114: What does a Timesheet file sent by a Unit User change?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Unit User's file is saved only as corrections to Submitted and Approved Timesheets.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0003`](business-rules.md#req-time-0003), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0015`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0015)

<a id="d-122"></a>

### D-122: Which Unit User actions ask for confirmation before they are saved?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Cancelling a Shift asks for confirmation, and choosing Block first warns what it removes.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0004`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0008`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0008)

<a id="d-124"></a>

### D-124: Which screens does an Instawork Admin have?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Instawork Admin menu is Home, Positions, Markets, Labor rules, Account team, and Outside ids, and Billing from Phase 2.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001), [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](every-user.md#req-shell-0009)

<a id="d-130"></a>

### D-130: What does a second SALES or BUDGETS row for the same Unit and dates do?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It replaces the first: the row is proposed as an update to the saved record.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0005`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0005), [`REQ-REPORTING-0007`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0007)

<a id="d-139"></a>

### D-139: Where does a Unit User give the reason for corrections sent in a Timesheet file?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** In a reason column, one reason for each line. A Unit User's line without one is a problem the uploader completes or drops.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0003`](business-rules.md#req-time-0003), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0015`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0015)

<a id="d-165"></a>

### D-165: Does a change to a recurring Shift apply to one Shift or to its series?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit User chooses: one Shift, or every Shift of the same line that has not started.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0004`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0004), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0017`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0017)

<a id="d-175"></a>

### D-175: Can anyone change or remove an Audit Trail entry?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. No User of any role, and no other part of Iris, changes or deletes one.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AUDIT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-audit-0001), [`REQ-SHELL-0011`](every-user.md#req-shell-0011)

<a id="d-176"></a>

### D-176: Who is left out of a notification?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Deactivated Users, the User whose action caused it, and any channel the recipient has no address for.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

<a id="d-177"></a>

### D-177: Which ways of writing a date, a time, or an amount does Iris read in a file?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Month-first slash dates, 12-hour and 24-hour times, and money with a dollar sign or thousands commas, each offered as a suggested fix to the template's form. Each catalog column has a kind that INTAKE checks.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0005`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0005)

<a id="d-187"></a>

### D-187: Can a Shifts file cancel a Shift?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A file creates and changes Shifts and assigns Workers. It never cancels a Shift or changes its Unit, Position, or Department (C-39).
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0003), [`REQ-ORDERING-0014`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0014)

<a id="d-192"></a>

### D-192: What happens when a new Rate Line repeats the rates already in effect?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It changes nothing and is not submitted, so loading the same rate card again is harmless.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-RATES-0002`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0002), [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009)

<a id="d-204"></a>

### D-204: Are the parts of a split Timesheet checked for exceptions one by one or together?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Together: the first part's clock-in, the last part's clock-out, and the total break are checked, and every part carries the result.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0005`](business-rules.md#req-time-0005), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0003`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0003)

<a id="d-208"></a>

### D-208: What does each Home show below its to-do list?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit Home shows a spend summary, the Program Home shows Units ranked by spend, and the Agency Home shows nothing more in MVP.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0011`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0011), [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0014`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0014)

<a id="d-219"></a>

### D-219: Does a Unit's Market follow later changes to a Market's ZIP codes?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A ZIP code added to a Market moves the Units with that ZIP code to it. Removing a ZIP code from a Market changes no Unit.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-CATALOG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0002), [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)

<a id="d-224"></a>

### D-224: How does a person settle the problems on a Proposal item?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An item with no problem counts as accepted, and one with problems only when each has a fix or a picked candidate, which replaces the fix. Otherwise it is edited, which keeps the values as the person leaves them, or rejected.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002), [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0002)

<a id="d-229"></a>

### D-229: How are a Timesheet's clock times and worked minutes kept?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Clock times are kept to the whole minute. Worked minutes are zero until both clock times are entered, and every path that changes hours saves them through the one requirement that recomputes the minutes.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001), [`REQ-TIME-0008`](business-rules.md#req-time-0008)

<a id="d-231"></a>

### D-231: What does a list show when it has no rows?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It says so in words, says when filters are the cause, and offers to clear them.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0012`](every-user.md#req-shell-0012), [`REQ-SHELL-0013`](every-user.md#req-shell-0013)

<a id="d-237"></a>

### D-237: Which thread does an inbound email or text join?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An email joins the thread of the message it replies to, matched by the provider's message id, and a text joins the sender's last text thread when that had a message in the past 24 hours. Anything else starts a new thread.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001), [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-256"></a>

### D-256: Can an Instawork Admin replace the only Program User after that User accepted their invite?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. While exactly one active User who accepted holds a Program User grant, an Instawork Admin may revoke it and then invite a replacement. With two or more, Program Users manage one another.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001), [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)

<a id="d-39"></a>

### D-39: What does Iris do with an email, text, or call from a sender it cannot match to one active User?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It stores the message, creates no Upload or Proposal, and tells the sender it does not recognize them: an email or text sender at most once in 24 hours, a caller on every call. A number that matches several Users counts as no match.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-47"></a>

### D-47: What status does a Shift take when it ends with no Worker assigned?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Unfilled, not Worked. It becomes Worked if a Worker is later assigned to it from a Timesheet.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0008)

<a id="d-48"></a>

### D-48: What does Iris remember about each Unit when it books by email, SMS, or phone?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Nothing extra. A message that leaves out the times, Department, or Agency for a Position is filled from the Unit's most recent Shift for that Position that was not cancelled, and the draft shows what was filled.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0010)

<a id="d-49"></a>

### D-49: How do the rows of a Shifts file become Requests?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The rows of one file that create Shifts at the same Unit form one Request.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0014`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0014)

<a id="d-62"></a>

### D-62: Which tasks are on a Unit User's to-do list?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Timesheets to review, headcount to send, and badge requests to issue at secured Units. Outstanding invoices join in Phase 2.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0014`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0014)

<a id="d-63"></a>

### D-63: Which starters does the assistant offer a Program User?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Ask a spend question, upload Units, upload Agencies, upload a Rate Card, and download a template.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0001`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0001)

<a id="d-79"></a>

### D-79: Which values may a whole-number Setting take?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** 0 or more: a negative tolerance, Lock Window, threshold, or warning period is refused, and no upper limit is set.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0010`](business-rules.md#req-org-0010)

<a id="d-86"></a>

### D-86: How long does Iris keep trying a Credential check that cannot finish?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A job that runs every five minutes (D-67) checks each Credential waiting for its checks. A run in which the document model returns no usable answer leaves the Credential waiting, and the third such run sends it to a Program User for review.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003)

<a id="d-92"></a>

### D-92: How is a Shift's local start or end time read on a day the clocks change?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A time that does not exist on its date, because the clock skips it, is refused. A time that occurs twice is read as the earlier of the two.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001)

<a id="d-100"></a>

### D-100: Who words each notification?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No source gives the wording, so the requirement that owns a notification type words a title and a plain-text body from the facts its rule names. The title is the email's subject line and the inbox heading, and a text carries the body only.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001)

<a id="d-105"></a>

### D-105: Which requirement takes a request sent by email, text, or phone?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0010`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0010) alone, in MVP. Anything it refuses is answered with its reason.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-111"></a>

### D-111: When is a Timesheet created?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Draft Timesheet is created for each assigned Worker when the Shift ends.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001)

<a id="d-112"></a>

### D-112: How is a Timesheet's clock time read on a day the clocks change?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A time the clock skips is refused, and one that occurs twice is read as the occurrence nearest the scheduled time.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001)

<a id="d-116"></a>

### D-116: What is the narrowest phone screen every page must work on?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every page works at a width of 360 px.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0001`](every-user.md#req-shell-0001)

<a id="d-118"></a>

### D-118: What does the in-app inbox show?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The inbox shows an unread count, holds the notifications of every context, and opening one opens its record.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007)

<a id="d-119"></a>

### D-119: How does a screen show a refused action?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It shows the reason beside the action, keeps what was typed, and shows no change.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0013`](every-user.md#req-shell-0013)

<a id="d-121"></a>

### D-121: How does a Unit User who covers several Units work across them?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A Unit User over several Units sees them together and can narrow every screen to one Unit, a choice that lasts until they change it or sign out.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0001`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0001)

<a id="d-143"></a>

### D-143: How do the rows of a UNITS file become Units and Departments?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The rows that name one Unit make it together, with one Department for each row that names one. A file only adds Units, so a row for a Unit already in Iris is dropped.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0003`](business-rules.md#req-org-0003)

<a id="d-145"></a>

### D-145: How often is an Agency warned that a Credential is expiring?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Once for each Credential, by a daily job at 08:00 in the program timezone, for a verified Credential not yet warned that no newer one replaces. A later change to the warning days does not warn again.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002)

<a id="d-147"></a>

### D-147: How does a reply by email or text approve a Proposal?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A reply that says only yes, approve, or confirm applies the thread's one open Proposal when every item can be accepted, and no, reject, or cancel rejects it; code, not the LLM, checks the words. Any other reply is passed on as a new message.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-148"></a>

### D-148: What does the voice agent do on a phone call?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It asks each question aloud and reads a Proposal's summary, passing what the caller says to the handling requirement. A call is one thread and one stored message whose body becomes the transcript, and it ends when the caller hangs up or is silent for 30 seconds.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-150"></a>

### D-150: What happens when a User is granted a role and scope they already hold, or held before?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A User may hold any number of Role Grants. One that repeats an unrevoked role and scope is refused, and granting a revoked one again restores the old grant and records who restored it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)

<a id="d-163"></a>

### D-163: Can a Shift be booked for a time that has passed?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A new Shift must end in the future.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0001`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0001)

<a id="d-183"></a>

### D-183: Which Position and Department does a measure group by when a Timesheet was split to another?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Headcount and fill rate group by the Shift's Position and Department, spend and hours by the Timesheet's, and every measure by the Shift's Event.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-REPORTING-0002`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0002)

<a id="d-188"></a>

### D-188: How does a Shifts file send a new Shift to an Agency?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An agency named on a new row receives the Shift's whole headcount at the contracted rate. A file carries no Bill Rate, so a row whose agency has no contracted rate is a problem, and the agency column is not read on a row that changes a Shift.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORDERING-0014`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0014)

<a id="d-197"></a>

### D-197: Can a Credential file add a Worker who is not yet in Iris?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A document that names no Worker of the Agency is a problem.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002)

<a id="d-205"></a>

### D-205: Which tasks are on an Agency User's to-do list?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Releases to answer, Releases to staff, Timesheets to submit, Timesheets sent back, Credentials to renew, Rate Reviews to answer, and Worker issues to resolve.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0011`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0011)

<a id="d-206"></a>

### D-206: Which tasks are on a Program User's to-do list?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Credentials to review, rate changes to approve, and rates above their peers that never had a Rate Review. Anomalous invoices join in Phase 2.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0013`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0013)

<a id="d-210"></a>

### D-210: What does the assistant do with a typed request that no requirement owns?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It creates no Proposal and says it cannot make that change.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0003`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0003)

<a id="d-211"></a>

### D-211: Is a conversation with the assistant kept?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** For the session only. The assistant lists the User's open Proposals each time it opens, whichever channel they came through.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0001`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0001)

<a id="d-212"></a>

### D-212: Does a reporting answer say how the question was read?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes. Each answer states the measures, groupings, filters, and dates it used.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0004)

<a id="d-215"></a>

### D-215: How does an Agency add one expense to several Workers of a Shift?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** By asking the assistant. Everyone who worked a Shift means each Draft or Rejected Timesheet of the Agency's Workers on it that is not a no-show; the others are left out and named.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)

<a id="d-216"></a>

### D-216: How is an expense file row matched to a Timesheet?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Its Shift by shift id, or else by Unit, date, and Position, and its Worker as a Timesheet row's is. An expense for a split Timesheet goes to its first part.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)

<a id="d-218"></a>

### D-218: What does changing a Unit's time zone do to its Shifts and Timesheets?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It moves no stored instant. Their local times and work dates, past and future, are read in the new zone from then on, so the change is for correcting a wrong zone.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0002`](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)

<a id="d-220"></a>

### D-220: What becomes of a request for a Worker by name when the Agency's Release closes?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It stays with the Shift, hidden while that Agency holds no pending or accepted Release on it, and shows again if the Shift is sent to that Agency again.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004)

<a id="d-228"></a>

### D-228: What does Iris do with a file column that matches no catalog column?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It leaves the column out of every item and names it in the Proposal's summary.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002)

<a id="d-230"></a>

### D-230: How is a clock time read when a file gives it with no date?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** As the occurrence of that time nearest the Shift's scheduled start, for a clock-in, or end, for a clock-out.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIME-0003`](business-rules.md#req-time-0003)

<a id="d-232"></a>

### D-232: In which timezone does a screen show the times of a Shift?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Unit's, whoever is looking and wherever they are.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0013`](every-user.md#req-shell-0013)

<a id="d-254"></a>

### D-254: What must a typed request to assign Workers say?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each Worker's first and last name, and the Shift by its Unit, Position, date, and start time. It becomes a Proposal that only assigns, saved under the assignment rules once the Agency User approves it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0018`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0018)

<a id="d-255"></a>

### D-255: Does a typed request that names a person who matches no Worker of the Agency propose a new Worker?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes, as a SHIFTS file row does. The item proposes a new Worker with the name given and says so, and the Worker is created when the item is saved.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0018`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0018)

<a id="d-270"></a>

### D-270: Who keeps billing details for Sectors and Agencies?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Program Users keep Sector Billing Profiles, purchase orders, and each Agency's legal name, remit-to address, Payment Terms, and payee number, as Compass's payables data. Instawork Admins keep the Payment Terms list and VMS fees. Agency Users see only their own.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-272"></a>

### D-272: How does Iris charge its VMS fee?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The Agency pays it: a percentage of each issued Agency Invoice's total, set per Agency by an Instawork Admin. Each month Iris issues each Agency one fee statement for the month before. Compass never sees the fee on its invoices.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-274"></a>

### D-274: May one User both run Iris and act for an Agency?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A User holding INSTAWORK_ADMIN is never granted AGENCY_USER, and the reverse, so the people who run Iris stay neutral among Agencies even when Instawork is also one of them.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)

## Instawork engineering (27)

<a id="d-107"></a>

### D-107: How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Each role's menu and Home page are one requirement, built before that role's other screens. Whatever an earlier screen shows of or opens in a later feature, such as a menu item, tab, link, Home section, field, upload button, or a notification's page, is added by the later requirement.

<a id="d-67"></a>

### D-67: How often does timed work run?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every five minutes. A daily job runs at the local time its requirement names, in each Unit's timezone, or in the program timezone for work that belongs to no Unit.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003), [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002), [`REQ-JOBS-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-jobs-0001), [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001), [`REQ-ORDERING-0008`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0008), [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001), [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

<a id="d-106"></a>

### D-106: How does a platform requirement use product records, which it may not read?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It never reads them. The product or screen requirement that calls it supplies what it needs, such as the acting role, a notification's recipients, a table's rows, or the result of a lookup, and keeps anything that must outlast the call.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0003), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0004`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0004), [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001), [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0003), [`REQ-INTAKE-0005`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0005), [`REQ-JOBS-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-jobs-0001), [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001), [`REQ-MESSAGING-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0002)

<a id="d-98"></a>

### D-98: When does a sign-in end?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** When the User signs out, is deactivated, or resets their password, or when 12 hours pass without a request. A User may have several open Sessions.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0004`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0004), [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](every-user.md#req-shell-0004), [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](every-user.md#req-shell-0009)

<a id="d-267"></a>

### D-267: Which outside systems' ids does Iris keep for its records?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Compass's systems only: Fieldglass, SAP, and MyStaff ids for Companies, Units, Departments, Agencies, and Positions, at most one per system per record. Instawork Admins keep them, and no Iris rule needs one to be present. Instawork's own back-office systems are not Iris data.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001), [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0006`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0006), [`REQ-INTEGRATIONS-0009`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-integrations-0009), [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-97"></a>

### D-97: What does Iris create when it starts?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** At every start Iris creates only what is missing: the first Instawork Admin from the deployment configuration, that User's INSTAWORK_ADMIN grant, and the 15 Positions when the catalog is empty. It never changes or reactivates an existing record, and does not start when the configuration it needs is incomplete.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-CATALOG-0001`](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)

<a id="d-142"></a>

### D-142: Who may read a stored file?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Every file is stored privately and read only through INTAKE: by the requirement that holds its reference, or by a User that requirement says may see it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)

<a id="d-221"></a>

### D-221: Where is the role a User is acting in kept?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** On the Session, which starts with none. The screens set it, [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009) defines it, and IDENTITY stores it without reading it.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009), [`REQ-SHELL-0002`](every-user.md#req-shell-0002)

<a id="d-236"></a>

### D-236: Can a requirement store a file that is not an Upload?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Yes: a PDF, JPEG, or PNG within the size limit, such as a Worker's photo or a Credential document entered on a form. INTAKE returns a reference that the requirement keeps.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001), [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)

<a id="d-99"></a>

### D-99: What does the Audit Trail record when a record is deactivated, revoked, or cancelled?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** An UPDATE, as for any change that keeps the record. A DELETE is recorded only when the record is removed from Iris.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AUDIT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-audit-0001), [`REQ-IDENTITY-0004`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0004)

<a id="d-141"></a>

### D-141: Who checks and saves a file column that belongs to a requirement other than the upload type's owner?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** INTAKE calls only the type's owner. The owner passes each such column to the requirement the catalog names in saved_by, whose rules check and save it, so that requirement is always one the owner depends on.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENCIES-0010`](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0010), [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002)

<a id="d-223"></a>

### D-223: Where is an invite or reset link kept until its email is sent?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Apart from the body, on the Notification, and only while it is queued. It is erased once the message is sent or has failed, and is never shown in the app or written to the Audit Trail.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002), [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001)

<a id="d-261"></a>

### D-261: How is a problem reported on a file cell that lists several names?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** One problem for each name that fails, naming that entry. Its fix or picked candidate replaces that entry only, so two wrong names in one cell are settled one at a time.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002), [`REQ-INTAKE-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0002)

<a id="d-38"></a>

### D-38: How often is an email or text that fails to send tried again?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** It is first tried as soon as the change that caused it is saved, then by a job every five minutes, three tries in all. It is then marked failed, without undoing the change.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001)

<a id="d-101"></a>

### D-101: What does REQ-AGENT-0001 deliver, when its rules bind every flow that uses the LLM?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** One gateway that makes every LLM call: a caller passes a text or a file and the fields to read, or facts to put into words, and gets back a value for each field or a failure. The gateway reads and changes no record.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0001)

<a id="d-103"></a>

### D-103: How does Iris tell which upload type a file is?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** The LLM maps the file's columns to each registered type's catalog columns, and code picks the fitting type that covers the most of them; none or a tie asks the uploader. For a PDF or image, the LLM names the type its OCR text holds.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001)

<a id="d-120"></a>

### D-120: Are to-dos stored, or worked out each time a page loads?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** To-dos are computed, never stored.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-SHELL-0003`](every-user.md#req-shell-0003)

<a id="d-138"></a>

### D-138: Which requirement saves a tip typed in the assistant?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001) registers the one save step of the TIP_ENTRY kind. It saves an Agency User's tip itself and hands a Tip Pool to [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), as file intake hands a row to its upload type's owner.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001)

<a id="d-140"></a>

### D-140: When does an upload type become available to users?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only once the requirement that owns it is delivered and has registered it with INTAKE. Until then the type is not offered on the Uploads page, is not detected in a file, and has no template.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001)

<a id="d-146"></a>

### D-146: How does Iris make sure a job runs once?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** A daily job runs once for each timezone and local date, recorded as a JobRun saved with the run's changes. Only one run of a job is in progress at a time, and a repeated run changes nothing the first already changed.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-JOBS-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-jobs-0001)

<a id="d-151"></a>

### D-151: What may a new session do before the User has chosen a role?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** Only list the User's contexts, choose one, and sign out.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-222"></a>

### D-222: What do the before and after of an Audit Trail entry hold?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** For an UPDATE, only the fields that changed. A CREATE holds the whole new record in new_values, and a DELETE the whole record in old_values.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AUDIT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-audit-0001)

<a id="d-226"></a>

### D-226: How large may a file be?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** 10 MB and 5,000 rows. A larger file is refused, and one with more rows fails.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001)

<a id="d-227"></a>

### D-227: Which part of a workbook is read?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** One sheet: Excel means .xlsx, the first row with a value is the header, and a workbook with rows on more than one sheet fails. An image is a JPEG or PNG.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001)

<a id="d-239"></a>

### D-239: Is a timed job checked against a role?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. It acts as SYSTEM, for no User.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="d-259"></a>

### D-259: Is a daily run that was missed for a whole local date made later?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** No. A daily run is made only on its own local date, and the next day's run does the work, so each daily job acts on what is true when it runs.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-JOBS-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-jobs-0001)

<a id="d-275"></a>

### D-275: What does Iris keep about each LLM call?

- **Status:** open
- **Assumed until answered:** One record per call: the caller, purpose, model, acting User, the record read, token counts, duration, and outcome. The input and output text are kept 90 days for debugging and evaluation, then cleared.
- **Cited by:** [`REQ-AGENT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0001)
